sections.heading: Summary
sections.paragraph: Microbiologist (Ph.D.) with 7 years of GMP QC microbiology: environmental monitoring, endotoxin and real-time PCR release testing, and microbial deviation investigations.

bullets.text: Wrote 12 environmental monitoring SOPs for a client's new cleanroom suite, approved by the client's QA team.
Trained 5 client technicians on aseptic technique and gowning qualification.
Ran environmental monitoring for 4 ISO 7 cleanrooms and trended results monthly for the site quality review.
Validated 3 real-time PCR assays for mycoplasma release testing with the QC lead, cutting result time from 28 days to 2 days.
Performed LAL kinetic chromogenic endotoxin testing on about 300 water and in-process samples a month.
Led 6 microbial data deviation investigations to closure, each within 30 days.
Built a real-time PCR panel for 8 gut anaerobes, used in 2 published studies.
Mentored 3 graduate students on anaerobic culture.
Studied biofilm formation in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, running real-time PCR on 14 quorum-sensing genes.
Taught 4 semesters of the undergraduate microbiology lab, about 24 students each.
